factual_errors.text: 1 J of work is done when a force of 1 N moves an object 1 m. So 1 J = 1 N m
factual_errors.correction: The bullet leaves out the direction. It should say that 1 J of work is done when a force of 1 N causes a displacement of 1 m along the line of action of the force. keyPoints[3].content states this correctly, but the summary bullet does not. The spec says: "One joule of work is done when a force of one newton causes a displacement of one metre" and "distance moved along the line of action of the force".
